profile.name: Saiful Khan
profile.headline: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer and AWS Solutions Architect
profile.summary: Saiful Khan focuses on AWS, platform engineering, automation, secure cloud architecture, event-driven systems, CI/CD, and infrastructure that can be operated in production.

experience.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
highlights: Built serverless credential management using Lambda, Secrets Manager, EventBridge, and CloudFormation StackSets.
Operated ECS Fargate and EKS platforms with ECR pipelines, EFS storage, ALB ingress, and autoscaling.
Created reusable GitHub Actions workflows adopted by more than 20 business-critical applications.
Implemented multi-cloud AI infrastructure using AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
Improved observability and automation, contributing to a 40 percent MTTR improvement.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
highlights: Built serverless applications with API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, and Aurora.
Implemented event-driven deployment automation and container delivery pipelines.
Provisioned AWS networking, IAM, databases, messaging, and compute with CloudFormation and Terraform.

experience.title: Infra Engineer
highlights: Designed highly available AWS infrastructure and automated operations with Lambda and Python.
Managed ECS workloads, blue-green deployments, networking, IAM, monitoring, and alerting.

projects.name: AWS Serverless CRUD with Terraform
projects.summary: A serverless CRUD application using API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, Python, IAM, and Terraform.
projects.dataStored: Application records are stored in DynamoDB. Terraform configuration defines the infrastructure, and Lambda validates and processes CRUD requests.

projects.name: AWS Cloud Resume Challenge
projects.summary: A production-style personal website hosted on AWS with secure delivery, serverless APIs, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code in progress.
projects.architecture: Route 53 -> CloudFront -> S3; API Gateway -> Lambda -> DynamoDB
projects.dataStored: The visitor counter stores a visit count in DynamoDB. The contact form API can store submitted contact messages in DynamoDB.

projects.name: AWS Employee Management Application
projects.summary: An authenticated serverless CRUD application for employee records using Cognito, API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudFront, CloudWatch, and SNS.
projects.architecture: CloudFront -> S3; Cognito -> API Gateway -> Lambda -> DynamoDB; CloudWatch -> SNS
projects.dataStored: DynamoDB stores employeeId, name, email, department, designation, and joiningDate.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What AWS projects has Saiful built?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Saiful built the AWS Cloud Resume Challenge, an AWS Serverless CRUD application using API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, and Terraform, and an authenticated employee management application using Cognito and serverless AWS services.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What does the CRUD project store in the database?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: The CRUD project stores application records in DynamoDB. Lambda handles validation and create, read, update, and delete operations.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What technologies does Saiful use?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: His main technologies include AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Python, GitHub Actions, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is Saiful available for work?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Saiful is available for selected opportunities. Visitors can use the contact form or LinkedIn profile on the website.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Where can I find the source code?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: The website and project repositories are linked from the homepage and project detail pages on khansaiful.com.
